description: This script initializes ethernet addresses for specific board types during system setup, by setting environment variables with MAC addresses obtained from network interfaces. It is likely used in device firmware initialization, particularly within an OpenWRT-based environment.

methods.name: fw_printenv
methods.description: Reads environment variables from firmware storage.

methods.name: fw_setenv
methods.description: Sets environment variables in firmware storage.

methods.name: macaddr_add
methods.description: Calculates a new MAC address by adding an offset to an existing MAC address.
